note: the graded episode's service (graded_service.py): public constants only; the hidden episode is episode.json, which only the worker reads. cell_sha256 pins online/cell/, byte copies of tests/keyed_env.py, keyed_render.py, keyed_look.json and keyed_credit.py (the grader's cell, its cameras and its credit rule). env is the grader's rendering and thread environment (the image's ENV and tests/test.sh's MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE). image_charge_s and image_budget_s are tests/grader_config.json's image_charge_s and controller_budget_s: the graded episode charges every image a step asks for against the kit's 600 s, as the grader does (the controller's own time, which the grader also counts, does not exist here). prep_s is the agent's budget on main ([agent] timeout_sec 28800): the episode must be started within it; graded_s is the window from the start to the episode's latest end. practice_flag (O13): the graded episode's start writes it, and the commissioning service ends its episodes and refuses new ones once it exists. The dual mode's freeze (DM3): at the graded start, or when the start window closes without one, the root supervisor copies submission_dir into record_dir/snapshot_name (no link followed, only what the agent's account owns; snapshot_max_files and snapshot_max_bytes are main's caps, 5000 files and 200 MiB; entries and depth bounded so that the copy finishes and stays within the engine's artifact limits).
